text: No past life has been lived to lend us glory, and that which has existed before us is not ours.
author: Seneca

text: Reflect how pleasant it is to demand nothing, how noble it is to be contented and not to be dependent upon Fortune.
author: Seneca

text: When you have done a good act and another has received it, why do you look for a third thing besides these, as fools do, either to have the reputation of having done a good act or to obtain a return?
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: All things that are still to come lie in uncertainty; live straightway!
author: Seneca

text: Only time can heal what reason cannot.
author: Seneca
